# xelon_backup_plan (Data Source)

The backup plan data source resolves an existing cloud-owned backup plan by its exact, case-sensitive name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "xelon_backup_plan" "daily" {
  cloud_id = data.xelon_cloud.example.id
  name     = "Daily Backup, kept for 5 days"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_id` (String) ID of the cloud that owns the backup plan.
- `name` (String) Exact, case-sensitive name of the backup plan.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) ID of the backup plan.
